LanguageData.VRE_CanineEars.description: Carriers of this gene will grow wolf-like ears.
LanguageData.VRE_CanineEars.label: canine ears
LanguageData.VRE_CanineNose.description: Carriers of this gene have wolf-like noses.
LanguageData.VRE_CanineNose.label: canine nose
LanguageData.VRE_CanineTail.description: Carriers of this gene grow a wolf-like tail that helps them with movement slightly.
LanguageData.VRE_CanineTail.label: wolf tail
LanguageData.VRE_ChestFur.description: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur on their chest.
LanguageData.VRE_ChestFur.label: chest fur
LanguageData.VRE_DodgeDisabled.description: Carriers of this gene are incapable of dodging attacks. Lack of combat perception results in being hit by every swing - even the one that would miss.
LanguageData.VRE_DodgeDisabled.label: dodge disabled
LanguageData.VRE_GermlineReimplanter.description: Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their germline into another person through an injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Xenogenes will be unaffected.
LanguageData.VRE_GermlineReimplanter.label: germline reimplanter
LanguageData.VRE_ImprovedDodge.description: Carriers of this gene can dodge attacks more easily. Extra-capable in perception, they anticipate attacks before they happen.
LanguageData.VRE_ImprovedDodge.label: improved dodge
LanguageData.VRE_IntenseLightSensitivity.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their eyes that react dangerously to light photons. They are intensely sensitive to any light sources.
LanguageData.VRE_IntenseLightSensitivity.label: intense light sensitivity
LanguageData.VRE_LightSensitivity.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their eyes that react painfully to light photons. They are unusually sensitive to any light sources.
LanguageData.VRE_LightSensitivity.label: light sensitivity
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_AdulthoodMorphing.description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process when reaching adulthood. It cannot be stopped or prevented. They will never morph back.
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_AdulthoodMorphing.label: adulthood morphing
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_DamageMorphing.description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process when badly wounded, and will only morph back when almost fully regenerated.
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_DamageMorphing.label: damage morphing
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_NocturnalMorphing.description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process every night. It cannot be stopped or prevented. They will only morph back come morning.
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_NocturnalMorphing.label: nocturnal morphing
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_RandomMorphing.description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process seemingly at random. Nobody knows what the morphing condition is, or whether it can be controlled in any way. Morphing will occur in random time intervals.
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_RandomMorphing.label: random morphing
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_SeasonalMorphing.description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process on 1st of Septober, and then morph back on 1st of Aprimay.
LanguageData.VRE_Morphs_SeasonalMorphing.label: seasonal morphing
LanguageData.VRE_MoveSpeed_ExtremelyQuick.description: Carriers of this gene have a special type of muscle-stimulating cell that allows them to move at superhuman speeds.
LanguageData.VRE_MoveSpeed_ExtremelyQuick.label: extremely fast runner
LanguageData.VRE_Nocturnal.description: Carriers of this gene prefer to work at night. They are happier if awake at nights and unhappy if awake during the day.
LanguageData.VRE_Nocturnal.label: nocturnal
LanguageData.VRE_OnlySideburns.description: Male carriers of this gene experience rapid beard growth on the sides of their face.
LanguageData.VRE_OnlySideburns.label: only sideburns
LanguageData.VRE_PackMentality.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of forming tightly knit communities, and become happier the stronger their community is.
LanguageData.VRE_PackMentality.label: pack mentality
LanguageData.VRE_Photophobia.description: Carriers of this gene have an intense fear of light. When any light source is close, there is a chance they will have a mental breakdown at any moment.
LanguageData.VRE_Photophobia.label: photophobia
LanguageData.VRE_SpeechInability.description: Carriers of this gene lost the ability to understand and partake in the act of talking.
LanguageData.VRE_SpeechInability.label: speech inability
LanguageData.VRE_SuperiorDarkVision.description: Carriers of this gene see much better low light than well lit areas, and are unaffected by mood penalties related to darkness. They have a reflective layer behind the retina that amplifies their ability to see in the dark.
LanguageData.VRE_SuperiorDarkVision.label: superior dark vision
LanguageData.VRE_SuperiorDodge.description: Carriers of this gene can dodge attacks very easily. Extra-capable in perception, they anticipate attacks before they happen.
LanguageData.VRE_SuperiorDodge.label: superior dodge
LanguageData.VRE_Territorial.description: Carriers of this gene are extremely territorial and will feel more calm in their own land, and at the same time increasingly uneasy as they leave it.
LanguageData.VRE_Territorial.label: territorial
LanguageData.VRE_WarHowl.description: Carriers of this gene can perform a wicked warhowl, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call on their allies to fight more aggressively.
LanguageData.VRE_WarHowl.label: warhowl
